create_BaselineTrainer: create a supervised-only trainer class extending DefaultTrainer for standard object detection training
create_UBTeacherTrainer: create an unbiased teacher semi-supervised trainer with student-teacher model ensemble for pseudo-labeling
build_train_loader: build a semi-supervised training data loader with two-crop augmentation for labeled and unlabeled data
test_student_teacher_models: test both student and teacher models periodically during semi-supervised training evaluation hooks
update_teacher_model: update teacher model weights using exponential moving average from student model parameters
